correctness.rationale: Exact three-neighbor Potts recoloring energy difference J(N_old-N_new) yields >=2 matching neighbors iff strict stability. A disagreeing rung propagates ordered row colors both directions; agreeing rungs reduce to cyclic words with no singleton runs. The q^2-state color-pair transfer has characteristic factors x^(q(q-2))(x²-x-(q-1)u)(x²-x+u)^(q-1), giving F_n and, after correct stripe energy weighting, Z_n. Spectral-gap quasi-powers near u=1 give exact entropy, wall LLN, nondegenerate CLT, and by exponentially rare stripes the energy LLN/CLT. Twelve exhaustive independent Hamiltonian enumerations totaling 2,123,582 arrays and 40 direct transfer-trace equalities passed. Formal n=1,2 transfer checks are not asserted physical.

originality.rationale: The exact frozen-energy polynomial and domain-wall Gaussian law for all integer q>=3 on the degree-three circular ladder were not implied by the inspected 2013 Potts coarsening article, 1996 single-chain dynamical domain article or 2000 antiferromagnetic strip chromatic article, nor by the known binary-ladder or one-ring kinetic results. Direct physical models, implications and restrictions were compared; unindexed historical enumeration remains a risk, not proof of novelty.
residual_risks: An older specialized q-state Potts strip metastability enumeration not indexed by the searches could contain the same classification or energy polynomial.

value.rationale: A natural physical question is whether the pinned multicolor domain mosaic of zero-temperature square-lattice Potts dynamics survives minimal-width confinement. Degree-three two-leg geometry forces a sharp dichotomy, permitting an all-color, all-length energy density-of-states polynomial and rigorous finite-density Gaussian wall statistics. The exact energy spectrum and typical frozen density are useful benchmarks for quasi-1D kinetic models and contrast with reachability observables. q>=3 classification is not a mere recount of the known binary case; it includes arbitrary labeled colors and an additional (q-1)-fold spectral branch. Limits: no dynamical reachability or neutral-rate recurrent behavior.
